title: Faithful Decoding
summary: This paper studies transformations that increase efficiency in solving equilibrium systems without information loss. Our approach exploits order-theoretic structure commonly found in economic problems to obtain conditions under which high-dimensional systems can be transformed into low-dimensional systems while preserving exact relationships between their solutions. The transformations can also be used for purposes other than dimensionality reduction, such as simplifying analysis and facilitating stochastic approximation routines.
